integration: Local playback interface with original lyric effects, Polaroid and Lattice views; playback, library and playlists are owned by Mineradio through the local frame bridge.

featureSync.scope: Selective port: Hanabi, Nebbia including performance patches, Machi, subtitle row layout, Lattice harmony, random styles and live previews. Existing embedded local-player boundaries are retained.

incrementalSync.scope: Selective follow-up port: staged/asynchronous Machi program warmup, global lyric rendering quality and per-style overrides, Nebbia preview sizing, whitespace/RTL lyric layout, Nebbia aquarium/rain/dew and transparent player integration. Not a full upstream version upgrade. Selective follow-up: Classic/Partita overlap geometry and local Lattice current-song-only numeric badges. Shared GlowWord/timing/layout helpers extracted as required by the overlap implementation. No Bravais, account, cloud sync or provider application port. Local command search, configurable playback slots and subtitle tools follow PR #1014 using an isolated local registry and the existing host bridge. Audio effects/output are exposed from Mineradio without adopting upstream audio services.
